effect.name: GM Hue Shift Fan
effect.desc: A hue rotation arranged as a fan around a point. The angle around the centre is divided into blades and each blade carries its own hue offset, so the colour sweeps round the layer like a colour wheel instead of shifting all at once. Blade count, hue per blade, a global hue rotation, spin, a spiral twist that bends the blades as they travel outward, a radius limit and a falloff that fades the shift with distance are all independent, and the blades can be feathered so the fan reads as a smooth sweep rather than as segments. Layer space, so the fan centre rides the layer.
